rationale: The original complete-1991-2017 colony panel failed its predeclared 75% retention gate only on Christine Island. A descriptive identifier audit showed structured reporting discontinuities centered on 2006/2007 rather than diffuse missingness. This validation addresses that metadata discontinuity without changing the original result or threshold.

phase_definition.basis: The boundary is fixed at the observed multi-code reporting discontinuity: CHR 3.1 and 4.2 and TOR 6.0 cease after 2006, while CHR 11.0 appears from 2007 onward.

colony_eligibility.candidate: island-specific colony_code with at least one positive breeding-pair observation inside the phase
colony_eligibility.eligible: candidate code reported in every year of the phase and with non-zero temporal variance in annual log1p growth
colony_eligibility.rationale_for_positive_history: all-zero administrative/reporting rows contain no demographic trajectory and cannot contribute a correlation
colony_eligibility.retention_gate: eligible / positive-history candidate codes >= 0.75 on every included island, with at least two eligible codes per island

statistic.response: annual colony growth = diff(log1p breeding pairs)
statistic.contrast: Fisher-mean within-island pairwise growth correlation minus Fisher-mean between-island pairwise growth correlation
statistic.expected_direction: positive, based on the frozen exploratory primary result
statistic.significance: retain the original two-sided abundance-stratified pseudo-island permutation test and additionally require positive observed contrast

null.construction: permute island labels within five fixed rank strata of phase-specific colony mean log1p abundance

primary_validation.rule: island coherence replicates only if both early and late phases pass the validity gate, both contrasts are positive, and both two-sided permutation p-values are <= 0.05

litchfield_sensitivity.rule: signal is not Litchfield-driven only if both early and late extant-only contrasts are positive with two-sided permutation p <= 0.05 and both validity gates pass

overall_rule: strong confirmation requires both primary phase replication and the extant-only sensitivity. Otherwise report the exact component outcomes without rescue analyses.
interpretation_boundaries: This validates island-label demographic coherence, not a coastline effect independent of geographic distance.
Positive within-island synchrony does not identify migration, habitat, foraging, or observer error as the mechanism.
The previously proposed within-island spatial-insurance hypothesis remains unsupported and is not retested here.
Do not alter phase boundary, completeness threshold, candidate-code definition, number of abundance strata, transform, statistic, or null after outcomes are opened.
